author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Direct-hit disclosure button does not expose expanded state.
findings.consequence: Assistive technology users can operate the button and the input receives focus when opened, but the control itself does not announce whether the direct-hit form is currently expanded or collapsed.
findings.evidence: Line 98 renders the local disclosure command as `<button type="button" class="reader-action-button" @click="toggleGoto">Gå direkt till träff . . .</button>`, while line 99 shows and hides the associated form with `v-show="gotoOpen"`; no `aria-expanded` or `aria-controls` connects the button state to the revealed form.
findings.recommendation: Add `:aria-expanded="gotoOpen"` to the button and give the form or a wrapper a stable id referenced by `aria-controls`, preserving the existing button semantics and focus behavior.
